The settings themselves feel right, including keeping the toolbar and Settings choice in sync. Browser-only remembering is fine for this prototype, but in the finished web app I’d expect my preferences to follow me between my computer and phone.

I’m not ready to lock the whole scope yet. “Manage” still includes some important situations we haven’t explored: deleting links, putting links aside in a reversible archive, adding notes, changing many selected links at once, saving useful search-and-tag combinations, keeping a preserved copy of a page, and importing or exporting my bookmarks. I’d like to work through those behaviours before we call the scope complete.
